documents.text: Welcome to our frequently asked questions. If you need to cancel before the deadline, the entire payment is returned as money with no deduction. Internal notes for the Alder offer: Cancellations prior to the cutoff result in a full monetary return with zero deductions. Check-in is seamless at 01:30 without prior arrangement. While the booked accommodation features an operational onsite pool available during the stay without a separate fee, be aware that our unbooked offer policy charges guests 19 euros for pool entry in addition to the holiday price. The quoted amount strictly covers accommodation; guided hikes incur an extra 38 euros. Note that the distractor belongs to a different, unselected Birch offer and does not apply here.

Frequently Asked Questions: Cancelling before the cutoff incurs a mandatory 27 euro administration charge. Guests arriving at 01:30 cannot check in without prior permission. Please contact support for clarification on the conflicting facility terms.
